Team —

Quick heads-up: Finance and GTM leadership have finalized a small set of definition tweaks for how we classify Commit vs Best Case vs Pipeline. These are targeted changes (not a wholesale taxonomy rewrite) but they materially affect how we mark quarter-end commits and forecast coverage.

Why this matters now:
- We need consistent signals for Q4/yr-end forecasting and for Reserved/Dedicated capacity planning.
- A few large deals (ACME, Prospect.io) drove inconsistent stage use in the last two sprints.

Ask:
1) Please review the attached one-pager (commit_vs_bestcase_onepager.pdf) before Monday.
2) Update any active opportunities that are affected by the new examples by EOD Wed (2026-11-24).
3) Attend one of the 45-minute calibration sessions next week — we are running 3 slots to match APAC/US times. Register via the Drive folder link below.

We’ll run a short sprint ("Forecast Hygiene Sprint") next week where AMs + RMs will:
- confirm stage for all >$50k opportunities closing in next 90 days
- reclassify where necessary and add a 1-line rationale in the opportunity notes
- tag any deals that need Product/Legal review for commit gating

Logan — can you own the sprint roster and the follow-up audit?
Marissa — please coordinate comms to the AEs and include the step-by-step in the sales playbook.
Karthik — please confirm the examples in the attached doc and add any edge-cases I missed.

Thanks,
Vivek

Adding more color on the definitions — attached is the one-pager and a short FAQ. Main clarifications:
- Commit: explicit customer-signed agreement (or fully-executed PO) OR a firm verbal buy-commit from an authorized buyer + documented payment timeline. Use Commit only if both the commercial and delivery conditions are satisfied.
- Best Case: high confidence (>70%) that the deal will close this quarter but missing either the signed doc or the confirmed payment trigger.
- Pipeline/Others: all deals where the timing is uncertain or where required compliance/PO terms are under negotiation.

Edge cases:
- Large enterprise (>$1M): maintain a gating note — don't mark Commit without Legal sign-off even if procurement verbally commits.
- Partner-sourced deals: require partner confirmation and documented co-sell plan to qualify as Best Case.

Attachments: 2026-11-21_commit_vs_bestcase_onepager.pdf; 2026-11-21_hygiene-sprint-agenda.docx

Karthik
